name: chat-monitor
description: A side pane, In this chat, in a quiet card layout: a summary card with the total, a bar of where creds went and tiles for cache hits, cold sends, the priciest prompt and the average per prompt; lists with tiles, tags and sort menus; a to-do stepper; the to-do list, connectors, websites, files, subagents with their creds and skills with their creds (instructions, skill list line and the turns that used them) this chat has used; failed and blocked calls; what loads into every message in creds, unused connectors and skills first; the total and each subagent's creds by Claude Code's own cost estimate; and a Copy button (/chat-monitor copy) for a Markdown summary

autoOpen.title: Open by itself
autoOpen.description: Open the pane the first time this chat uses a connector, file or skill, or gets a to-do list.

names.title: Connector names
names.description: Names for connectors that only show an id, as id=name pairs separated by commas. The first characters of the id are enough: 1a59=Docs, 7a9f=Meetings.

slowSeconds.title: Slow call (seconds)
slowSeconds.description: A call that runs at least this many seconds is marked slow in its connector's or website's call list.

cacheMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: Prices creds as taskband does: 60 on a subscription; 5 once the session is billed as extra usage. Keep it the same as taskband's.
